cert_fields_required.text: Name, certificate, and private key are required

database_already_attached.text: That database is already attached to this site

database_immutable.text: Managed databases cannot be edited; destroy and recreate instead

database_in_use.text: Database '{$name}' is attached to {$sites}; detach it from those sites first

database_remote.text: Database '{$name}' runs on server '{$server}': its port is only published on that host's loopback, so sites on this server cannot reach it

hostname_taken.text: That hostname is already configured for this site

local_server_immutable.text: The implicit local host cannot be edited

local_server_undeletable.text: The implicit local host cannot be removed

name_format.text: Use only lowercase letters, digits, and dashes

prefix_format.text: The env prefix must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, and underscores

prefix_taken.text: Env prefix '{$prefix}' is already used by another database on this site

site_type_no_injection.text: Sites of type '{$type}' cannot receive database credentials: only host-process site types (Node.js, Alchemy, Command) can reach a managed database

ssh_target_format.text: SSH target must be a plain [user@]host[:port]

url_scheme.text: The URL must start with http:// or https://

api_keys.text: Keys accepted by the managed process API. Add one key per row.

allowed_ips.text: One IP address or CIDR network per line, for example 203.0.113.8 or 10.0.0.0/8.

auto_deploy.text: Deploy when the repository webhook or polling detects a new revision.

autoindex.text: Show a directory listing when no index file exists.

basic_auth_user.text: Optional username required in addition to the IP rules.

basic_auth_password.text: Leave blank on edit to keep the stored password; its value is never sent back to the browser.

branch.text: Git branch to check out. Leave blank to use the repository default.

build_command.text: Shell command run after checkout and before a deployment becomes active.

build_directory.text: Working directory for the build command, relative to the repository root.

build_environment_variables.text: Environment variables available only while building the repository.

build_timeout.text: Maximum build duration in seconds before the deployment is cancelled.

container_command.text: Optional command that overrides the image's default command.

container_port.text: TCP port on which the application listens inside the container.

cpu_limit.text: Maximum CPU cores available to the container. Leave blank for no limit.

delay.text: Artificial delay in milliseconds before handling each request.

denied_ips.text: One IP address or CIDR network per line, for example 203.0.113.8 or 10.0.0.0/8.

dockerfile.text: Path to the Dockerfile, relative to the repository root.

environment_variables.text: Variables passed to each application process at runtime.

fallback_file.text: File served when the requested path does not exist, for example index.html for an SPA.

forward_host.text: Hostname or IP address of the HTTP upstream.

forward_port.text: TCP port of the upstream. Defaults to 80 for HTTP and 443 for HTTPS.

forward_scheme.text: Protocol used to connect to the upstream.

ignore_certificates.text: Accept an invalid or self-signed certificate from the upstream.

image.text: Image name to run when no Dockerfile build is used.

image_tag.text: Tag applied to a locally built image.

indexes.text: Serve conventional index files such as index.html from directories.

maximum_processes.text: Upper scaling limit for concurrently running application processes.

memory_limit.text: Maximum container memory in megabytes. Leave blank for no limit.

minimum_processes.text: Number of warm application processes Hohenheim keeps running.

node_runtime.text: Discovered Node.js version used to start this site.

poll_interval.text: Seconds between repository checks when polling is enabled.

port_argument.text: Command-line argument placed before the allocated port number.

preserve_path.text: Append the original request path and query string to the redirect target.

redirect_status.text: HTTP status code returned for the redirect.

repository_url.text: Git clone URL. SSH authentication uses the server's configured SSH keys.

rewrite_location.text: Rewrite upstream redirects so they keep using the public site hostname.

root_path.text: Absolute directory containing the files to serve.

run_as_user.text: System account used for the child process, including its uid, gid and home directory.

script.text: Application entry script, relative to the working directory.

server.text: Host on which the container will run.

shallow_clone.text: Fetch only the latest history to reduce checkout time and disk use.

show_hidden_files.text: Allow files whose names start with a dot to be served or listed.

source.text: Use files already on this server or deploy them from a Git repository.

start_command.text: Executable and arguments used to start each application process.

submodules.text: Initialize and update repository submodules after checkout.

target_url.text: Absolute URL or root-relative path to which requests are redirected.

upstream_socket.text: Unix socket path. When set, it takes precedence over host and port.

use_ports.text: Allocate a loopback TCP port instead of the default Unix socket transport.

volumes.text: Container bind mounts in host-path:container-path form.

wait_for_ready.text: Route traffic only after the child reports that startup completed.

webhook_secret.text: Secret used to verify signed repository webhook requests.

websocket_upgrade.text: Forward WebSocket upgrade requests to the upstream.

working_directory.text: Directory in which the application command is started.

auto_deploy_disabled.text: Auto-deploy is disabled for this site: pushes are acknowledged but not deployed. Enable it in the site's source settings.

certificate.text: TLS certificate served for this hostname. Blank lets the platform pick or request one.

empty_description.text: Attach a managed database and its connection details are injected into this site's processes as environment variables.
Add a hostname so traffic routes to this site.
Webhook, poll or manual deploys of this site will show up here.

engine.text: Database engine. Fixed after creation; destroy and recreate to change it.

env_prefix.text: Names the injected variable family: DB gives DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_NAME and DB_URL. The site's first attachment also provides DATABASE_URL.

hostname.text: The Host header to match. Wildcard mode allows * and ?; regex mode takes a full regular expression.

match_type.text: How the hostname is compared: exact, wildcard, or regular expression.

restore_description.text: Uploads a dump file and loads it into the running database.

rollback_confirm.text: Activate the previous deploy slot? The current version stops serving.

terminal_description.text: Live stdout/stderr for pid {$pid}. Keystrokes are sent to the process's stdin.

unmanaged_description.text: Only node, alchemy, command and docker sites run managed processes.

webhook_description.text: Configure this URL and secret on your git host (GitHub, GitLab or Gitea) to deploy on every push.

description.text: Running child processes for this site.
Choose how the application runs, add a domain, then request a certificate. Hohenheim guides each step from the site page.

publish_description.text: Add every value below at your DNS provider. Values sharing a name must coexist; do not replace one with the other.

manual_ephemeral.text: This order remains available for 30 minutes and is lost when Hohenheim restarts. Manual DNS certificates do not auto-renew.

record_name.text: Owner name relative to the zone: @ for the zone itself, www for a subdomain, * for a wildcard

record_value.text: A/AAAA: an IP address. CNAME/NS/MX/SRV: a hostname. TXT: the text. CAA: flags tag value, e.g. 0 issue letsencrypt.org

domains_help.text: Comma or whitespace separated. Wildcards such as *.example.com require DNS-01 and do not cover the bare example.com name; include both when needed.

validation_help.text: HTTP-01 requires each exact hostname to route to this proxy. DNS-01 works for exact and wildcard names.

hook_ready.text: The configured hook publishes and removes TXT values, so this certificate can renew automatically.

hook_missing.text: Configure ssl.dns_hook_command in Settings to enable automatic DNS-01 issuance and renewal.

account_email_help.text: Overrides the global Let's Encrypt account email for this certificate.

proxy_unavailable.text: The proxy server is not available yet

dns_validation_failed.text: DNS validation failed. Verify every TXT value and start a new request.

domain_required.text: At least one domain is required

excluded_hostnames.text: Excluded from Let's Encrypt by their domain settings: {$hostnames}

hook_not_configured.text: The automated DNS hook is not configured in SSL / TLS settings

manual_expired.text: The manual DNS request expired or the server restarted. Start a new request.

clone_confirm.text: Create a copy with the same settings and domains (disabled by default)?

site_type.text: How this site is served: managed process, static files, proxy, redirect, ...

enabled.text: Disabled sites are not routed; requests get the offline page.

access_list.text: Optional IP allow/deny list and basic auth applied before requests reach the site.

auth_provider.text: Optional identity provider visitors must authenticate with before reaching the site.

listen_on.text: Only serve this domain on the selected local IP address. Blank means all interfaces.

path_prefix.text: Only requests whose path starts with this prefix use this entry. Blank matches everything.

strip_path.text: Remove the matched path prefix before forwarding the request upstream.

force_ssl.text: Redirect plain HTTP requests to HTTPS.

hsts_enabled.text: Send the Strict-Transport-Security header so browsers refuse plain HTTP for this host.

custom_headers.text: Headers set on the request before it is forwarded upstream. An empty value removes the header.

response_headers.text: Headers set on the response sent to the client. An empty value removes the header.

exclude_from_letsencrypt.text: Leave this hostname out when requesting Let's Encrypt certificates for the site.

database_name.text: Unique name for this managed database; also names its container and volume. Lowercase letters, digits, and dashes.

db_user.text: Username created in the database container and injected into attached sites.

db_password.text: Password for the database user. Leave blank to generate one.

db_name.text: Name of the initial database created inside the engine.

ephemeral.text: Store data in a RAM-backed tmpfs: fast, but ALL data is lost when the container restarts.

origin.text: The domain this zone is authoritative for, e.g. example.com (no trailing dot)

soa_primary_ns.text: Hostname of the primary name server (the MNAME in the SOA record); leave empty for ns1.<zone>

soa_contact.text: Administrative contact for the zone; leave empty for hostmaster@<zone>

default_ttl.text: Seconds resolvers may cache records that set no explicit TTL (3600 = 1 hour)

negative_ttl.text: Seconds resolvers may cache name-does-not-exist answers (300 = 5 minutes)

soa_refresh.text: Seconds before a secondary name server re-checks this zone (7200 = 2 hours)

soa_retry.text: Seconds a secondary waits after a failed refresh before retrying (3600 = 1 hour)

soa_expire.text: Seconds after which a secondary that cannot reach this server stops answering (1209600 = 2 weeks)

zone_enabled.text: Disabled zones are not served and their names get REFUSED answers

record_type.text: The record type; MX and SRV also need a priority, SRV also needs a port

record_ttl.text: Seconds resolvers may cache this record; leave empty to use the zone default

record_priority.text: Required for MX and SRV records; lower numbers are tried first

record_weight.text: SRV only: relative weight for records with the same priority (0 when unsure)

record_port.text: SRV only: the TCP/UDP port the service listens on

record_enabled.text: Disabled records stay stored but are not served

ds_description.text: Lodge this DS record with your domain registrar to complete the DNSSEC chain of trust. It changes if you regenerate the signing key.

dnssec_enabled.text: Generate a signing key on first use and serve signed answers. Requires lodging the DS record (shown on the Zone file tab) with your registrar.

records_empty_description.text: Add A/AAAA records for your hosts and NS records for the zone itself.

zone_file_description.text: The zone in standard master-file format; disabled rows appear as comments.

import_description.text: Paste standard zone-file text to load records into this zone.

import_replaces.text: Importing replaces every record of this zone except ACME-managed entries. SOA lines are ignored; the zone form owns those values.

dns_origin_format.text: Enter a bare domain like example.com (letters, digits and hyphens; no wildcard, no trailing dot)

dns_origin_taken.text: A zone for that origin already exists

dns_zone_required.text: Pick the zone this record belongs to

dns_name_format.text: Use @ for the zone itself, or labels like www, *.dev or _acme-challenge

dns_ipv4_format.text: Enter a valid IPv4 address like 203.0.113.10

dns_ipv6_format.text: Enter a valid IPv6 address like 2001:db8::1

dns_cname_apex.text: A CNAME cannot live on the zone itself; use an A/AAAA record instead

dns_cname_exclusive.text: A CNAME owner cannot hold any other record; remove the conflicting records first

dns_ns_wildcard.text: NS records cannot use a wildcard name

dns_priority_required.text: MX and SRV records need a priority between 0 and 65535

dns_port_required.text: SRV records need a port between 0 and 65535

dns_weight_format.text: The weight must be between 0 and 65535

dns_caa_format.text: CAA values look like: 0 issue letsencrypt.org

dns_caa_tag.text: The CAA tag must be issue, issuewild or iodef

dns_interval_range.text: SOA intervals must be between 0 and 2419200 seconds (four weeks)

dns_ttl_range.text: TTL values must be between 0 and 604800 seconds (one week)

dns_record_duplicate.text: That exact record already exists in this zone

dns_contact_format.text: Enter an email address like hostmaster@example.com

internal_ready.text: Hosted DNS: available when the domain's zone is served by this server; validation records publish instantly.

internal_unavailable.text: Hosted DNS: enable the DNS server and create a zone for the domain to use this.

zone_not_hosted.text: No enabled hosted DNS zone covers: {$hostnames}

dns_server_disabled.text: The DNS server is not running; enable it in the settings first

dns_zone_no_ns.text: Delegation needs NS records on the zone itself; resolvers will treat it as broken.

empty_hint.text: Start a Zenit project with the dev tunnel configured and it will appear here automatically.
Add a peer to replicate this zone to it over authenticated AXFR.

registration_token.text: Secret that remote dev servers present when they register. Generated automatically when left blank; paste it into the dev machine's zenit-dev config.

peer_base_url.text: HTTPS URL of a Hohenheim peer's admin server, for forwarding edits of zones it owns.

peer_api_key.text: znit_ API key used to call the peer's admin for edit forwarding.

peer_transfer_host.text: Address of the peer's DNS server for AXFR/NOTIFY.

peer_tsig_key_name.text: Shared key name authenticating zone transfers with this peer.

peer_tsig_secret.text: Base64 shared secret for the TSIG key.

dns_secondary_linked.text: That peer is already a secondary of this zone

edits_forwarded.text: This zone is owned by peer "{$peer}": the records below are read live from it and edits are forwarded there.

edit_saved.text: Change applied on the owning peer

delete_confirm.text: Delete this record on the owning peer?

remote_empty_hint.text: The owning peer reports no records for this zone.

peer_not_configured.text: The primary peer has no admin base URL / API key configured, so records are shown from the replica read-only.

peer_unreachable.text: The owning peer could not be reached ({$message}); records are shown from the replica read-only.

record_dynamic.text: Allow this A/AAAA record's address to be updated over the dyndns2 protocol; use the row action to mint an update token

dyndns_token_hint.text: Mint a new update token for this record (invalidates any previous one)

dyndns_only_address.text: Dynamic DNS is only available for A and AAAA records

dyndns_minted.text: Update token generated -- it is shown on this record's form

record_dyndns_token.text: The update password. Point a dyndns2 client (router, ddclient) at <host>/nic/update?hostname=<this record's FQDN> and send this token as the HTTP Basic password. Use the row action to (re)generate it

jar_path.text: Path to the application's fat/shadow jar.

java_binary.text: Path to the java launcher. Blank uses java from PATH (e.g. a jlink image's bin/java).

jvm_args.text: Extra arguments passed to the JVM before -jar, e.g. -Xmx512m.

app_args.text: Arguments passed to the application after the jar.
